G50, amendment 1, written in notes-D3.md (D3a-45, 20 October 2026, before any A18 line was ruled; it applies to every A18 line, and no line was ruled before it): G50 gave, as one act, a design that covers a work and mocks its makers; G20 reads a joke alteration of another's work as P09's move, and G21 reads lettering aimed at a rival as P18's taunt only where it covers no work; so a design that covers another's work is the attack, whatever its words, and not also the first taunt; the first taunt is the next act that carries the contest on in talk, or lettering that covers no work; a post that calls an attack and, in its own words, taunts or abuses the rival group stays one act. G50's readings 1 to 12, stated while reading A18's instantiate window i442_000 (25 lines), before its rows are written; none changes a rule beyond amendment 1. (1) An attack made during placement and told of or recounted after the close is the room's attack, placed before the report (G20's reading of utaustin-057 and zootopia-059); only an attack call first made after hour 73 falls under the close's reject (2007scape-065 c1320, a neighbour's grievance at h+91.32; belgium-052 c0210). (2) A justification in sarcastic words carries the contest on, as G21's reading of answers to a visitor holds, while a plain justification does not (2007scape-065 c1321: O-A, AC; EraseThePlace-051 c0291: NT). (3) Amendment 1 applied: a call to write an insult or joke over another's work is the attack's design, and the first taunt is the next act (4chan-075 c0230 then c0237; btc-048 c0117 then c0121; bakchodi-056 c0003 then c0010). (4) A call whose words slight the target's work or name the rival by a common slighting name is the call alone (49ers-060 c0047 above c0049; anarchocapitalism-015 c0002); a call framed as a taunt to the rival, or that abuses the rival group in words aimed at it, holds both ends in one act (canucks-072 c0059, on the same post as the call c0057: J). (5) Laughter alone in a post that reports the act names no rival and is not yet a taunt; a reply that gloats over revenge is (bangladesh-048 c0006 then c0010: O-A, VICT). (6) A post that reports the room's act as done and then gloats or taunts shows the order in its words, as G48's head 3 and G49's head 4 read reports (AprilKnights-060 c0076 and c0077; cardinals-058 c0101; belgium-052 c0210: O-H). (7) A taunt of the room's that follows an attack the room suffers, or the room's defence, is counted apart as SUF (DatBoi-055 c0044, a call to deflect a beam pushed through the room's work; TheHulk-051 c0038 after a visitor's threat; asexual-048 c0039; calgaryflames-058 c0182; catalunya-054 c0068, whose writer says the room was there first, G49 reading 113); an attack suffered with no taunt of the room's is NA (Goodboye-063). (8) The target's reply, threat or offer is set apart even when signed by its room, so it is not the room's taunt (austria-060 c0035; achievement_hunter-053 c0009; Thegreatblackhole-048 c0076: NT). (9) A call to remove invaders from the room's own place is defence (G49 reading 1), so anarcho_capitalism-068, C2's support transition (c0088 then c0089), shows defence first, and the threat after it is by a writer whose side cannot be read (G48 head 1): NA. (10) A reply that reports a member's heckling in the rival's chat as going on for a while places it only before the reply, so where the reply follows the call by minutes the two cannot be placed against each other (argentina-062 c0096 h+10.19, c0097 h+10.40: J). (11) A joking taunt at the rival's principle counts, since G21 holds that a taunt need not be meant in earnest (anarchism-065 c0050: O-A). (12) A war call in a post with no code cannot be the first end (aceattorney-050, one concept: ONE). Window i442_000 classed: O-A 7, O-H 4, SUF 5, NT 4, J 2, NA 2, ONE 1. Next: A18-inst-spec-1.txt
